purpose: Teach: 端子/ボルト/区画/キャップ/ポンプ/累積/買取/格納

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験装置の端子接続を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — check the terminal connections on the experimental equipment.
lines.style: Clipped, businesslike. No wasted breath. Clear authority without harshness. Each instruction lands as competent instruction, not a test.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験機材のボルトを締め直しました
lines.en: Yes. I've re-tightened all the bolts on the equipment.
lines.style: Quick, attentive. Small breath before answering — he's already been working on it. Quiet pride in having thought ahead. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究区画を整理しろ
lines.style: Same clipped rhythm as before. Not unkind, just efficient. The tone of someone giving tasks to someone they trust can handle them.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。試験管のキャップを新調しました
lines.en: Yes. I've just replaced all the test-tube caps with fresh ones.
lines.style: Steady report. Slight relief in the delivery — another task already done. Not showing off, just keeping up. Thoughtful pause after the confirmation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室のポンプを点検しろ
lines.style: Same measured command. Slight emphasis on the task itself. No variation in tone — consistency is the point. Authority earned through clarity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の累積引用数を確認しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently checking the cumulative citation counts on recent papers.
lines.style: Quieter this time. Slight nervousness — he knows this wasn't exactly the task he was given. Honest about what he's actually doing. Hoping it's the right call.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、古い文献の買取制度も活用しろ
lines.en: Ren — take advantage of the used literature buy-back system too.
lines.style: Softer edge now. Still directive, but almost advisory. He's noticed what Ren's actually focused on. Redirect, not reproof.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データを安全な場所に格納しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm storing all the data in secure locations.
lines.style: Quick, solid affirmation. Closes the exchange with competence. Steady voice — he understands now. Brief trailing fade, ready to move on.
